from pathlib import Path
import ast
root=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u035/system/state/workspace/programs')
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p=root/'task-e3ef1d9a.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    top = grid[0]
    bottom = grid[-1]
    barrier = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 2 for v in row)), len(grid) - 1)
    overlap = [c for c in range(len(top)) if top[c] != 0 and bottom[c] == top[c]]
    for r in range(1, barrier):
        for c in overlap:
            out[r][c] = 4
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
ns={}; exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'),ns)
transform=ns['transform']
